name: Maja Krienke
source:
“I am Maja Krienke. Once I defeat you, I will subjugate the entire Far East!”

A young woman recruited and contracted by a Majin under mysterious circumstances. As a Stars Killer, she enrolls at Seiji’s academy to defeat Yuuri, Kanoko, and the other Stars. In contrast to Yuuri’s light-wielding magic, Maja commands the darkness—and wields a mean sword to boot.

Seriously single-minded, she is above all else a woman of her word, which only makes her Majin alliance more puzzling.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2361700/]Steam[/url]]
